1. What is Shopify script optimization?

Shopify script optimization is the process of auditing and improving JavaScript, third-party app scripts, and asset loading to make your store load and respond faster.

2. Why does script optimization matter for my store?

Bloated or poorly loaded scripts slow down every page, hurting SEO, conversions and customer experience — optimization fixes this at the source.

3. Will optimization affect app functionality?

No. We defer and optimize how scripts load without removing needed functionality, so your apps and features work exactly as before.

4. How long does script optimization take?

The timeline depends on your app count and theme complexity. Simple optimizations may take a few days, while deeper fixes can take one to two weeks.

5. Can you optimize high-traffic Shopify Plus stores?

Yes. We optimize both small stores and large, high-traffic Shopify Plus stores for consistent speed at scale.

6. What typically slows down a Shopify store's scripts?

Common causes include too many third-party apps, render-blocking JavaScript, unoptimized images, and scripts that load before they’re needed.

1. What is Airabot?

Airabot is a PaaS AI chatbot builder powered by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). You upload documents or paste URLs, and the AI answers questions using only your content — no coding required.

2. How does Airabot avoid wrong answers or hallucinations?

Airabot bots answer only from your uploaded content using semantic vector search, and every response references the exact document chunks it came from, so answers stay accurate and verifiable.

3. Which channels can I deploy my Airabot bot on?

Yes. You can deploy one bot on your website with a single script tag and on WhatsApp via Twilio, including text messages and transcribed voice notes.

4. Do I need coding skills to build a chatbot?

No coding is needed. You upload your knowledge, configure the bot’s name, persona and model, then paste one script tag — your bot is live in minutes.

5. How does Airabot billing work?

Billing is simple and usage-based: 1 credit equals 1 message on a rolling 30-day window, with no subscriptions to juggle and no surprise overages.

6. Is my data secure with Airabot?

Yes. Airabot runs on Cloudflare’s global network with salted password hashing, signed sessions, request verification, and fully isolated knowledge bases per bot.

What is the process for developing an e-commerce mobile app for my business?

Our e-commerce app development process typically involves consultation, design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. We work closely with you to understand your business needs and tailor the app accordingly.

02
How can a food delivery app benefit my restaurant or food business?

A food delivery app can expand your customer base, increase revenue, and improve customer loyalty by offering convenient online ordering and delivery options. It also helps streamline operations and manage orders efficiently.

03

Yes, we provide comprehensive e-commerce web design services to create visually appealing and user-friendly online stores. Our design team ensures your website complements your brand and delivers a seamless shopping experience.

Absolutely. We specialize in Shopify development to create, customize, and optimize your online store. We can assist with theme development, app integration, and performance optimization.

WooCommerce is a versatile and user-friendly e-commerce platform for WordPress. It offers flexibility, scalability, and a wide range of plugins for customization, making it an ideal choice for online businesses.

06
What is multi-vendor app development, and how can it benefit my e-commerce platform?

Multi-vendor app development allows multiple sellers to list their products on a single platform. It enhances product variety, attracts more sellers, and increases the revenue potential of your e-commerce marketplace.

07
Can you explain the importance of SQL Server development services for my business?

SQL Server development services are crucial for database management, data analysis, and efficient data retrieval. They ensure your business has a robust and scalable database infrastructure to support applications and analytics.

How long does it typically take to develop an e-commerce mobile app or website?

The development timeline depends on the project’s complexity and specific requirements. Simple apps or websites can take a few months, while more complex ones may take six months or longer.

09
What measures do you take to ensure the security of e-commerce apps and websites?

We implement industry-standard security practices, including encryption, secure payment gateways, regular security audits, and vulnerability assessments to safeguard your platform and user data.

10
Do you provide ongoing maintenance and support for the apps and websites you develop?

Yes, we offer comprehensive maintenance and support services to keep your apps and websites up to date, secure, and running smoothly.

11
Can you integrate third-party payment gateways into my e-commerce app or website?

Yes, we can integrate a wide range of payment gateways to provide customers with flexible payment options, including credit cards, digital wallets, and more.

12
How do I get started with your services for my e-commerce project?

Simply reach out to us through our website or contact us via email or phone. We will schedule a consultation to discuss your project requirements and provide a tailored solution.

Our integrations keep Shopify and your ERP in perfect two-way sync, with orders, customers and products flowing automatically. With real-time updates, your teams always work on accurate data, eliminating manual entry and costly errors across systems.

Automated Order & Inventory Flow

With our connectors, you can automate the full order-to-cash cycle end to end, reducing cost and time. It supports both inventory sync across warehouses and fulfilment updates, delivering a consistent and reliable operations experience.

Real-Time Stock & Pricing Updates

Our integrations ensure accurate stock levels through scheduled and event-based syncs across channels and locations. Your store stays current using automated pricing rules that simplify catalog management and speed up day-to-day operations.

Frequently asked questions

1. What is Shopify ERP integration?

Shopify ERP integration connects your Shopify store with your ERP or accounting system so that orders, inventory, customers and finance data sync automatically between both platforms.

2. Why should I integrate Shopify with my ERP?

Integration eliminates manual data entry, prevents stock and pricing errors, speeds up order processing and gives you a single, accurate view of your ecommerce and back-office operations.

3. Which ERP systems can you connect with Shopify?

Yes. We integrate Shopify with SAP, Odoo, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, Tally, Zoho and QuickBooks, as well as custom and legacy systems via APIs.

4. How long does a Shopify ERP integration take?

The timeline depends on complexity, data volume and the systems involved. Simple syncs may take a few weeks, while advanced multi-system integrations can take several months.

5. Is the integration suitable for large stores?

Yes. Our integrations are scalable and suitable for both small stores and large enterprise-level ecommerce operations with high order volumes.

6. What data can be synced between Shopify and ERP?

We can sync orders, products, inventory, pricing, customers, invoices, shipments and refunds, and almost any data your business workflow requires.

7. Will the integration work in real time?

Yes. Integrations deliver near real-time sync using webhooks and scheduled jobs, so your data stays consistent across Shopify and your ERP.

8. Can you integrate my existing ERP setup?

Yes. Existing ERP and accounting setups can be partially or fully integrated with Shopify depending on requirements and API availability.

9. How does maintenance work for the integration?

Maintenance is simpler because the sync logic is centralised, which reduces effort when systems update or your workflow changes.

10. Do you provide support after the integration goes live?

Yes. We provide post-deployment support, monitoring, error handling and enhancements to keep your Shopify-ERP integration running smoothly.

content:
15

Years of experience

⸺Development services

Our Next-Gen Travel Agency Infrastructure

In today’s cloud-powered travel landscape, companies need intelligent solutions that improve efficiency, automate bookings, and enhance traveler experiences. Our travel infrastructure helps businesses build smart automation systems, custom portals, and scalable cloud applications using a flexible framework. At Intertoons, we provide expert Travel Agency Infrastructure Services in Kerala, helping startups, SMEs, and enterprises create custom travel workflows, AWS-compatible applications, business automation tools, and customer engagement solutions tailored for growth.

100+ clients trust our expertise.

We are committed to delivering solutions that create real business impact and long-term value.

The Role of a Trusted Travel Technology Partner

Intelligent Travel Solutions

We build custom booking-based solutions that automate tasks, optimize travel workflows, and improve business productivity.

Faster Platform Deployment

Our streamlined development process enables quicker implementation of travel tools, package management, and vendor systems.

Skilled Travel Development Team

Our experienced team specializes in travel portals, cloud-native AWS architecture, APIs, and enterprise automation systems.

Cost-Effective Cloud Services

We deliver scalable travel solutions that maximize ROI while reducing development time and operational costs through serverless architecture.

⸺HIGHLIGHTS

Travel Infrastructure Consultancy

We build secure, scalable, and high-performing travel solutions for modern businesses.
Proven expertise in destination management, workflow automation, and booking-powered applications.
Strong integration capabilities with luxury services (yachts, jets), APIs, databases, and third-party platforms.
Cloud-driven workflows designed to improve efficiency, engagement, and decision-making.
Serverless AWS solutions for faster deployment and easier long-term management.
Ongoing support, optimization, and upgrades for sustainable travel business growth.
⸺Basic information

Frequently asked questions

1. Is the platform compatible with serverless architecture?

The portal is designed specifically for AWS Lambda and serverless environments to ensure you only pay for the resources you use.

2. How does the multi vendor system work?

Vendors receive a private dashboard to upload their packages and manage bookings while the admin retains oversight and commission control.

3. Can I integrate third party APIs for flights or hotels?

The system is built with a flexible architecture that supports custom API integrations for external service providers.

4. Is the portal optimized for mobile users?

The entire interface uses responsive design principles to ensure a seamless booking experience across all mobile and desktop devices.

title: Magento , WooCommerce ECommerce Mobile Apps
content:
15

Years of experience

⸺Mobile Apps for Ecommerce Growth

Magento & WooCommerce App Solutions

In today’s mobile-first commerce landscape, businesses need powerful, native-like shopping experiences that drive conversions and build brand loyalty. Our mobile app services help e-commerce stores build high-performing, feature-rich iOS and Android applications using our specialized mobile framework.

At Intertoons, we provide expert Magento and WooCommerce Mobile App Development in Kerala, helping startups, SMEs, and enterprises transform their web stores into powerful mobile applications. We focus on seamless synchronization, user-centric design, and high-speed performance to ensure your customers have the best shopping experience on the go.

100+ clients trust our expertise.

We are committed to delivering solutions that create real business impact and long-term value.

The Role of a Trusted E-commerce App Partner

Seamless Sync Solutions

We build custom apps that sync perfectly with your Magento or WooCommerce backend, ensuring real-time updates for products, inventory, and orders.

Faster Time-to-Market

Our streamlined development process and pre-built core modules enable quicker deployment of your mobile store on the App Store and Google Play.

Skilled Development Team

Our experienced team specializes in Flutter, React Native, and native integrations, ensuring your app is robust, secure, and future-proof.

Cost-Effective Scalability

We deliver scalable mobile solutions that maximize ROI by reducing development overhead while providing a premium, enterprise-grade feel.

5.0

Google Rating

98%

Client Satisfaction

150+

Projects Delivered

⸺HIGHLIGHTS

E-commerce App Consultancy

We build secure, scalable, and high-performing mobile applications for modern online retailers.
Proven expertise in UX/UI design, push notification strategy, and checkout optimization.
Strong integration capabilities with payment gateways, shipping providers, and loyalty programs.
Mobile-first features designed to improve customer retention, engagement, and repeat purchases.
Hybrid and Native solutions for faster deployment and easier long-term management.
Ongoing support, regular updates for OS compatibility, and performance optimization.
⸺Basic information

Frequently asked questions

1. Will the mobile app sync automatically with my existing web store?

Yes. All product details, inventory levels, customer accounts, and orders are synchronized in real-time between your Magento/WooCommerce website and the mobile app.

2. Do you develop apps for both Android and iOS?

Absolutely. We specialize in cross-platform development (using frameworks like Flutter or React Native) which allows us to launch high-quality apps on both platforms simultaneously from a single codebase.

3. Can we integrate custom payment gateways into the app?

Yes, we can integrate any payment gateway that provides an API, including Razorpay, PayPal, Stripe, and local bank gateways, ensuring a secure checkout for your customers.

4. How long does it take to launch a standard e-commerce app?

Depending on the complexity and custom features required, a standard Magento or WooCommerce app can usually be deployed within 4 to 8 weeks.

5. Do you handle the App Store and Play Store submission process?

Yes, our team manages the entire submission process, ensuring your app meets all the technical guidelines and policies required for approval on both stores.

Frequently asked questions

1. What is a token management system?

A token management system is a digital solution used to manage queues efficiently by generating tokens and organizing customer flow in places like hospitals, banks, and service centers.

2. How does a token management system help businesses?

It reduces long queues, improves staff productivity, and enhances customer experience by organizing the waiting process and minimizing confusion.

3. What are the key features of a token management system?

Key features include token generation, real-time display, missed token recall, emergency tokens, queue monitoring, and detailed reports.

4. Can the system be customized for different industries?

Yes, it can be tailored for hospitals, banks, government offices, and other service-based businesses based on their requirements.

5. Is the token management system cloud-based?

Yes, modern systems are often cloud-based, allowing remote access, real-time updates, and easy scalability across multiple locations.

Frequently asked questions

1. How long does it take to see results from SEO?

SEO is a long-term investment. While technical fixes show early progress, significant ranking improvements typically take 3 to 6 months of consistent effort.

2. Can you guarantee the #1 spot on Google?

No ethical agency can guarantee the top spot due to changing algorithms, but we guarantee industry-standard best practices that significantly improve your rankings.

3. What is the difference between SEO and PPC?

PPC provides instant paid traffic, while SEO focuses on building “free” organic traffic over time. Both are most effective when used together.

4. Do you help with Local SEO for businesses in Kerala?

Yes, we specialize in helping businesses rank for local searches, ensuring customers in your area can find you easily when they need your services.

5. Is SEO a one-time service?

No. Because search algorithms and competitors are always changing, ongoing SEO is necessary to maintain and improve your search engine positions.

6. Do you provide ongoing support?

Yes, we offer continuous monitoring, maintenance, and performance optimization services.

A multi-vendor platform is an online marketplace where multiple sellers can register, list products, and sell to customers through a single website or app.

A multi-vendor platform allows multiple sellers with separate dashboards, while a single-vendor store has only one seller managing all products and orders.

Key features include vendor registration, product management, order tracking, commission management, payment integration, and admin dashboards.

Yes, each vendor gets a dedicated dashboard to manage products, pricing, inventory, and orders independently.

Revenue is typically generated through commissions on sales, vendor subscriptions, or listing fees.

Yes, multi-vendor platforms are designed to scale, allowing you to add more vendors, products, and features as your business grows.

7. Can payment gateways be integrated into the marketplace?

Yes, secure payment gateways can be integrated to manage transactions between customers, vendors, and the admin.

Yes, mobile apps for customers, vendors, and admins can be developed for seamless marketplace management.

The timeline depends on features and customization, typically ranging from a few weeks to several months.

Yes, ongoing support, updates, and maintenance services are provided to ensure smooth operation.

Node.js is a leading choice for building fast, scalable, and real-time applications. We develop high-performance, event-driven backends capable of handling thousands of connections with minimal latency—ideal for chat apps, streaming platforms, and enterprise systems.

By leveraging the power of the V8 engine, we create lightweight, efficient, and highly scalable solutions that grow seamlessly with your business.

Why Choose Node.js for Your Project?

Real-Time Performance

Ideal for applications requiring constant data updates, such as collaboration tools, instant messaging, and live tracking dashboards.

Highly Scalable Architecture

Node.js uses a non-blocking I/O model that makes it incredibly efficient for horizontal scaling across distributed systems.

Full-Stack JavaScript

By using JavaScript for both client-side and server-side development, we ensure better team synchronization and faster development cycles.

Rich Ecosystem

Frequently asked questions

1. What makes Node.js better than traditional backend frameworks?

Its asynchronous, non-blocking nature allows it to handle many more concurrent connections than traditional thread-based frameworks.

2. Is Node.js suitable for large-scale enterprise apps?

Yes. Major companies use Node.js specifically for its ability to handle massive scale and high traffic volumes efficiently.

3. Can you integrate Node.js with my existing frontend?

Absolutely. Node.js works perfectly as a backend for modern frontend frameworks like React, Angular, and Vue.js.

4. Do you provide microservices development using Node.js?

Yes, Node.js is particularly well-suited for microservices due to its lightweight nature and modular architecture.

5. How do you handle security in Node.js applications?

We implement industry-standard practices, including data encryption, secure authentication (JWT), and regular dependency audits.

Multi-agent systems consist of multiple AI agents that operate autonomously while collaborating to achieve shared objectives.

Yes. Each agent operates autonomously while sharing context and coordinating actions with other agents when needed.

Absolutely. Multi-agent architectures are designed to scale horizontally by adding more agents as workloads increase.

Shopify Headless Development is an approach where the frontend storefront is separated from the Shopify backend. This allows developers to build custom user interfaces using frameworks like Shopify Hydrogen, while Shopify continues to manage the commerce engine.

2. What is Shopify Hydrogen?

Shopify Hydrogen is a React-based framework developed by Shopify for building custom headless storefronts. It allows developers to create fast, scalable, and highly customizable eCommerce experiences.

3. What is Shopify Oxygen?

Shopify Oxygen is Shopify’s hosting platform designed specifically for Hydrogen storefronts. It enables fast deployment, global performance optimization, and simplified infrastructure management.

Yes. Shopify headless storefronts can be deployed and integrated with AWS and Microsoft Azure cloud environments to achieve better scalability, performance optimization, and enterprise infrastructure management.

A Shopify Storefront App is a custom frontend application built using Shopify APIs. While Shopify continues managing products, orders, payments, and inventory, the storefront app delivers a customized shopping interface for customers.

2. What is the difference between a Shopify theme and a storefront app?

A Shopify theme runs inside Shopify’s theme system, while a storefront app uses a headless architecture where the frontend is built separately using modern technologies such as React, Hydrogen, or Next.js.

3. Why should businesses use a Shopify Storefront App?

A storefront app enables businesses to build unique user experiences, faster websites, and flexible integrations with external systems like ERP, CRM, and logistics platforms.

4. Does a Shopify Storefront App require separate hosting?

In many cases, storefront apps can run using Shopify’s infrastructure such as Oxygen hosting, which eliminates the need for additional hosting costs.

5. Can storefront apps improve website performance?

Yes. Storefront applications use modern frameworks and optimized rendering techniques that improve page loading speed, SEO performance, and overall user experience.

6. Can mobile apps be built using the same Shopify backend?

Yes. The Shopify backend can power both web storefronts and mobile applications. Developers can create mobile apps using frameworks such as Flutter or React Native connected through Shopify APIs.

7. Can an existing Shopify store be converted into a storefront app?

Yes. An existing Shopify store can be upgraded to a headless storefront while Shopify continues managing the backend operations like products and orders.

Frequently asked questions

1. What is headless e-commerce development?

Headless e-commerce development separates the frontend and backend of an e-commerce platform, allowing for more flexibility and scalability. The frontend can be designed independently of the backend, which is powered by a CMS like Strapi.

2. Why choose Strapi for headless e-commerce?

Strapi is a highly flexible and customizable open-source CMS that allows developers to build powerful API-driven applications. It’s ideal for businesses looking to create a bespoke e-commerce platform that can scale with their needs.

3. Can you integrate Strapi with my existing frontend?

Yes, Strapi is designed to integrate seamlessly with any frontend technology. Whether you’re using React, Vue.js, Angular, or any other framework, we can connect your Strapi backend to it.

4. How long does it take to develop a Strapi-based e-commerce platform?

The timeline depends on the complexity and specific requirements of your project. Typically, it can take anywhere from 4 to 8 weeks to develop a fully customized Strapi-based e-commerce platform.

5. Is Strapi secure for e-commerce?

Yes, Strapi provides various security features, and we implement additional security measures to ensure your e-commerce platform is secure and compliant with data protection regulations.

6. Do you offer support after the e-commerce platform is launched?

Yes, we provide ongoing maintenance and support to address any issues and ensure your Strapi-based e-commerce platform continues to operate smoothly.

We offer fully customized ERP integrations, tailored to your business model and operational needs.

Yes! Our ERP integrations are built for scalability, supporting expansion across multiple platforms and regions.

A domain name is the web address users type into a browser to visit your website (example: yourcompany.com). It represents your brand identity on the internet.

2. How do I choose the right domain name?

Choose a name that is short, simple, easy to remember, and relevant to your business. It should reflect your brand and be easy for customers to type and recognize.

3. What is domain privacy protection?

Domain privacy protection hides your personal information (like email, phone number, and address) from public WHOIS databases to protect you from spam and misuse.

Yes, you can transfer your domain from another provider to us. We assist with the full migration process including DNS configuration and renewal setup.

5. What happens if my domain expires?

If your domain expires, your website and emails may stop working. We provide reminders and auto-renew options to prevent this from happening.

A managed dedicated server is a physical server fully allocated to your business, where all technical operations like monitoring, maintenance, updates, security, and troubleshooting are handled by professional server administrators.

2. What is the difference between Dedicated Server and VPS?

A dedicated server provides an entire physical server exclusively for your use, while a VPS (Virtual Private Server) is a virtual partition of a server with dedicated resources. VPS is more cost-effective, while dedicated servers deliver maximum performance.

3. Who should choose managed hosting services?

Managed hosting is ideal for businesses that need high performance, strong security, and 24/7 server support without managing technical tasks themselves — such as e-commerce sites, high-traffic websites, SaaS platforms, and enterprise applications.

Yes. Managed server services include firewall configuration, malware protection, OS updates, server hardening, DDoS protection, and regular security monitoring to keep your server and data safe.

Absolutely. Our team provides round-the-clock technical support for server management, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and emergencies.

Frequently asked questions

1. What is a “headless CMS”?

A headless CMS is a content management system that decouples the backend (where content is managed) from the frontend (where content is displayed). The CMS serves content through APIs, allowing you to deliver content to any frontend — website, mobile app, IoT device, etc.

2. Why choose headless CMS for eCommerce or websites?

Using a headless CMS offers flexibility — you’re not tied to a specific frontend — and scalability. It makes it easier to manage content centrally, reuse content across channels, and deliver fast, modern front-end experiences while keeping the backend robust.

3. What services does Intertoons offer under headless CMS/eCommerce development?

Intertoons offers custom headless CMS development (with platforms like Strapi, Contentful, Ghost, etc.), API-driven architecture, third-party integrations (payment gateways, analytics, shipping, etc.), multi-device / cross-platform support (web, mobile, etc.), secure deployment, SEO optimization, and ongoing maintenance/support.

4. What is “headless eCommerce”?

Headless eCommerce is an architecture where the storefront (frontend) is separated from the backend commerce logic (product data, orders, payments, inventory) — enabling companies to build custom, performant frontends while keeping a flexible, API-driven backend.

Frequently asked questions

1.What is WordPress?

WordPress is a popular content management system (CMS) that allows you to create and manage websites. It’s user-friendly and customizable, making it a great choice for a wide range of websites.

2. Why should I choose WordPress for my website?

WordPress is versatile, easy to use, and has a large community of users and developers. It offers numerous themes and plugins, allowing for extensive customization and functionality.

3. Can I convert my existing website to WordPress?

Yes, it’s possible to migrate your existing website to WordPress. This process involves moving your content and redesigning your site using WordPress themes and tools.

4. How long does it take to develop a WordPress website?

The development time varies depending on the complexity and size of the website. A basic WordPress site can be up and running in a few weeks, while more complex sites may take longer.

5. Is WordPress SEO-friendly?

Yes, WordPress is known for being SEO-friendly. It has features and plugins that help optimize your site for search engines, improving your site’s visibility.

6. Can I sell products on my WordPress website?

Absolutely. WordPress supports e-commerce functionality, especially with plugins like WooCommerce, which allows you to set up an online store and sell products.

7. What kind of support is available for WordPress?

WordPress has a vast community of developers and users who offer extensive support. This includes forums, tutorials, and guides. Additionally, Intertoons web development services provide ongoing support for WordPress sites done with us.

Frequently asked questions

1. What is Magento?

Magento is an open-source e-commerce platform that provides online merchants with a flexible shopping cart system. It offers powerful marketing, search engine optimization, and catalog-management tools.

2. Why should I use Magento for my online store?

Magento is highly customizable and scalable, making it ideal for businesses of all sizes. It offers a wide range of features, advanced security, and is known for its ability to handle large product catalogs and high traffic volumes.

3. Can Magento integrate with my existing systems?

Yes, Magento can integrate with various third-party systems and applications, including CRM, ERP, and payment gateways, enhancing the functionality and efficiency of your online store.

4. How secure is Magento for e-commerce?

Magento is known for its strong security features. It regularly releases security patches and updates to protect against vulnerabilities, making it a reliable platform for e-commerce websites.

5. What is the difference between Magento Open Source and Magento Commerce?

Magento Open Source (formerly Magento Community Edition) is a free version, suitable for small to medium-sized businesses. Magento Commerce (formerly Magento Enterprise Edition) is a paid version, offering additional features and support, ideal for larger businesses with more complex needs.

6. How does Magento support mobile commerce?

Magento offers responsive design themes and mobile-friendly features, ensuring that your online store provides an optimal shopping experience on smartphones and tablets.

7. What type of support can I expect for my Magento site?

Magento’s global community of developers and users offers extensive support through forums, guides, and tutorials. Intertoons Professional Magento development services also provide dedicated support for site maintenance, updates, and troubleshooting., for our clients

Rich Features & Fast Development

Flutter offers a rich set of APIs and UI components for smooth UI rendering, navigation, and quicker bug fixes. With Hot Reload, developers can instantly view changes, fix issues, and improve the app experience in real time.

Single Codebase with Native Experience

With Flutter, you can build two native apps using one codebase, reducing cost and time. It supports both Material Design for Android and Cupertino widgets for iOS, delivering a consistent and seamless user experience.

⸺Basic information

Frequently asked questions

1. What is Flutter?

Flutter is an open-source UI framework by Google that allows developers to build mobile apps for both Android and iOS using a single codebase.

2. Why should I choose Flutter for mobile app development?

Flutter offers fast development with hot-reload, native-like performance, a rich widget library, and reduced development time since the same code works on multiple platforms.

3. Can Flutter apps run on both Android and iOS?

Yes. Flutter allows you to build cross-platform apps that look and feel native on both Android and iOS.

4. How long does it take to develop a Flutter mobile app?

The timeline depends on complexity, features, and design. Simple apps may take a few weeks, while more advanced apps can take several months.

5. Is Flutter good for building large-scale applications?

Yes. Flutter is scalable and suitable for both small MVPs and large enterprise-level applications.

6. What types of apps can be built using Flutter?

Flutter can be used to build e-commerce apps, food delivery apps, educational apps, travel apps, CRM apps, healthcare apps, and almost any custom mobile application.

7. Does Flutter provide good performance compared to native apps?

Flutter apps deliver near-native performance because the framework compiles directly to machine code and does not rely on web views.

8. Can I migrate my existing Android/iOS app to Flutter?

Yes. Existing apps can be partially or fully migrated to Flutter depending on requirements and compatibility.

9. How does maintenance work for Flutter apps?

Maintenance is simpler because updates are made to a single codebase, which reduces cost and effort.

10. Will I get support for publishing apps to Play Store and App Store?

Yes. Assistance can be provided for app store submission, preparing assets, descriptions, and meeting store guidelines.

⸺Basic information

Frequently asked questions

What is custom mobile app development, and why do I need it?

Custom mobile app development involves creating tailored applications from scratch to meet your specific business needs. You need it to differentiate your brand, streamline processes, and engage your target audience effectively. Custom apps offer unique features and better scalability compared to off-the-shelf solutions.

How long does it take to develop a custom mobile app?

The development timeline varies depending on the complexity and features of your app. Simple apps may take a few months, while more complex ones could take six months or longer. We provide a detailed project timeline during the initial consultation.

What platforms can you develop custom mobile apps for?

We specialize in developing custom apps for both iOS (iPhone and iPad) and Android devices. Our team is proficient in using technologies like Swift, Kotlin, and React Native to ensure compatibility across platforms.

Do I have any control over the app development process?

Yes, we encourage client involvement throughout the development process. We provide regular updates, conduct meetings, and seek your feedback to ensure the app aligns with your vision and goals.

What about app maintenance and updates after the initial development phase?

We offer comprehensive app maintenance and support services, including regular updates, bug fixes, and performance enhancements. We ensure your app stays up-to-date with the latest OS versions and remains secure.

How do you ensure the security of my custom mobile app and user data?

Security is a top priority for us. We implement industry-standard security practices, including encryption, secure authentication, and rigorous testing to protect both your app and user data from potential threats.

What is the cost of custom mobile app development?

The cost varies based on factors such as the complexity of the app, desired features, platforms, and ongoing maintenance. We provide a detailed cost estimate after discussing your specific requirements in the initial consultation.

title: Privacy Policy
content:
Effective date: October 30, 2018

intertoons internet services pvt.ltd. (“us”, “we”, or “our”) operates the https;//intertoons.com website (the “Service”).

This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of personal data when you use our Service and the choices you have associated with that data. Our Privacy Policy for intertoons internet services pvt.ltd. is managed through Free Privacy Policy.

We use your data to provide and improve the Service. By using the Service, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. Unless otherwise defined in this Privacy Policy, terms used in this Privacy Policy have the same meanings as in our Terms and Conditions, accessible from https;//intertoons.com

Information Collection And Use

We collect several different types of information for various purposes to provide and improve our Service to you.

Types of Data Collected
Personal Data

While using our Service, we may ask you to provide us with certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify you (“Personal Data”). Personally identifiable information may include, but is not limited to:

  • Email address
  • First name and last name
  • Phone number
  • Cookies and Usage Data
Usage Data

We may also collect information how the Service is accessed and used (“Usage Data”). This Usage Data may include information such as your computer’s Internet Protocol address (e.g. IP address), browser type, browser version, the pages of our Service that you visit, the time and date of your visit, the time spent on those pages, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data.

Tracking & Cookies Data

We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track the activity on our Service and hold certain information.

Cookies are files with small amount of data which may include an anonymous unique identifier. Cookies are sent to your browser from a website and stored on your device. Tracking technologies also used are beacons, tags, and scripts to collect and track information and to improve and analyze our Service.

You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our Service.

Examples of Cookies we use:

  • Session Cookies. We use Session Cookies to operate our Service.
  • Preference Cookies. We use Preference Cookies to remember your preferences and various settings.
  • Security Cookies. We use Security Cookies for security purposes.
Use of Data

intertoons internet services pvt.ltd. uses the collected data for various purposes:

  • To provide and maintain the Service
  • To notify you about changes to our Service
  • To allow you to participate in interactive features of our Service when you choose to do so
  • To provide customer care and support
  • To provide analysis or valuable information so that we can improve the Service
  • To monitor the usage of the Service
  • To detect, prevent and address technical issues
Transfer Of Data

Your information, including Personal Data, may be transferred to — and maintained on — computers located outside of your state, province, country or other governmental jurisdiction where the data protection laws may differ than those from your jurisdiction.

If you are located outside Åland Islands and choose to provide information to us, please note that we transfer the data, including Personal Data, to Åland Islands and process it there.

Your consent to this Privacy Policy followed by your submission of such in formation represents your agreement to that transfer.

intertoons internet services pvt.ltd. will take all steps reasonably necessary to ensure that your data is treated securely and in accordance with this Privacy Policy and no transfer of your Personal Data will take place to an organization or a country unless there are adequate controls in place including the security of your data and other personal information.

Disclosure Of Data
Legal Requirements

intertoons internet services pvt.ltd. may disclose your Personal Data in the good faith belief that such action is necessary to:

  • To comply with a legal obligation
  • To protect and defend the rights or property of intertoons internet services pvt.ltd.
  • To prevent or investigate possible wrongdoing in connection with the Service
  • To protect the personal safety of users of the Service or the public
  • To protect against legal liability
Security Of Data

The security of your data is important to us, but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet, or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your Personal Data, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

Service Providers

We may employ third party companies and individuals to facilitate our Service (“Service Providers”), to provide the Service on our behalf, to perform Service-related services or to assist us in analyzing how our Service is used.

These third parties have access to your Personal Data only to perform these tasks on our behalf and are obligated not to disclose or use it for any other purpose.

Analytics

We may use third-party Service Providers to monitor and analyze the use of our Service.

  • Google Analytics Google Analytics is a web analytics service offered by Google that tracks and reports website traffic. Google uses the data collected to track and monitor the use of our Service. This data is shared with other Google services. Google may use the collected data to contextualize and personalize the ads of its own advertising network.You can opt-out of having made your activity on the Service available to Google Analytics by installing the Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on. The add-on prevents the Google Analytics JavaScript (ga.js, analytics.js, and dc.js) from sharing information with Google Analytics about visits activity.For more information on the privacy practices of Google, please visit the Google Privacy & Terms web page: https://policies.google.com/privacy?hl=en
Links To Other Sites

Our Service may contain links to other sites that are not operated by us. If you click on a third party link, you will be directed to that third party’s site. We strongly advise you to review the Privacy Policy of every site you visit.

We have no control over and assume no responsibility for the content, privacy policies or practices of any third party sites or services.

Children’s Privacy

Our Service does not address anyone under the age of 18 (“Children”).

We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from anyone under the age of 18. If you are a parent or guardian and you are aware that your Children has provided us with Personal Data, please contact us. If we become aware that we have collected Personal Data from children without verification of parental consent, we take steps to remove that information from our servers.

Changes To This Privacy Policy

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.

We will let you know via email and/or a prominent notice on our Service, prior to the change becoming effective and update the “effective date” at the top of this Privacy Policy.

You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes. Changes to this Privacy Policy are effective when they are posted on this page.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:

  • By email: support@intertoons.com
  • By visiting this page on our website: https://intertoons.com

title: Services
content:
our services

We craft high-performing software via expert engineering.

Custom software
agency

We deliver innovative ideas and strategic digital architecture that help brands stand out, connect with global audiences, and achieve measurable business success.

01

Wix Studio solutions

As a Wix Studio Legend Partner, we represent the highest tier of agency expertise. We design and launch pixel-perfect marketing sites and high-performance stores that don't just look good—they drive measurable business results.

  • Brand & marketing sites
  • Wix eCommerce setup
  • Legacy CMS migration
  • Technical SEO strategy
  • Checkout & payment flows
  • Custom site architecture
  • Pixel-perfect design
  • Performance optimization
02

Shopify solutions

As an Official Shopify Partner, we build stores held to the highest standards of performance and code quality. Whether launching on Shopify Plus or migrating from legacy carts, we ensure your commerce engine is built to scale.

  • Shopify Plus setup
  • Zero-loss migrations
  • Custom Shopify apps
  • Headless storefronts
  • Hydrogen & Remix builds
  • Native iOS/Android apps
  • Conversion engineering
  • One-tap checkout flow
03

Custom AI solutions

We build intelligent software that removes friction from your operations. From AI automations that handle repetitive busywork to custom workflow engines, we connect your digital stack into one coherent, high-performing system.

  • AI-driven applications
  • LLM & Vector search
  • Workflow automation
  • Agentic AI copilots
  • ERP & CRM integration
  • Custom mobile apps
  • Scalable web architecture
  • Internal Q&A tools

content:
about intertoons

Transforming brands through bespoke technology.

Software engineering
agency

We design, engineer, and ship custom software for global brands. From web apps to SaaS products, we build the digital infrastructure that solves complex business problems and drives measurable growth.

Years of Innovation.

Delivering award-winning custom software and innovative digital solutions for over a full decade.

Trusted by Brands.

Building high-performing digital stores and applications for leading global brands.

+

Global Presence.

Empowering global businesses with scalable technology and consultancy.

+

Successful Deployments

From bespoke SaaS products to complex e-commerce migrations and AI workflows.

+
⸺AWARD WINNING SOFTWARE PARTNER

We build custom solutions that solve business problems.

Intertoons is a dedicated development company focused on end-to-end solutions. We combine expert software consultancy with high-performance engineering to rescue stalled projects and launch successful digital products.

Let's talk now
More services
Trusted by clients. Recognized by the industry.

With over a decade of experience and a profile verified by Clutch, we deliver award-winning work across ecommerce and SaaS. Our team is committed to high-performing architecture and long-term strategic growth.

  • Decade of Experience: 10+years

  • Global Reach: 11+ Countries

  • Verified Success:Clutch Listed

90%
AI DEVELOPMENT
85%
New technology
150+ projects delivered.
We are excited about our work and its positive impact on clients.

Products we have built — ready for you to deploy

Not every project needs to start from scratch. Our in-house products give you a proven foundation you can launch in weeks, then extend with the custom work only your business needs.

Travel Portal

A complete booking engine for travel agencies, tour operators and DMCs. Flights, hotels, holiday packages, transfers and activities — with agent logins, markup rules, supplier APIs and a customer-facing storefront ready to brand.

Ready-to-Deploy CRM

A sales and service CRM configured out of the box for small and mid-sized teams. Leads, deals, pipelines, activity tracking, email and WhatsApp integrations and the kind of reports your managers will actually open.

AI Chatbot

A business-ready conversational AI you can plug into your website, WhatsApp or internal tools. Trained on your own content, grounded in your data and tuned to answer in your brand voice — not a generic bot.

Ready-to-Deploy Ecommerce Storefronts

Pre-engineered Shopify and Wix storefront templates built on our partner-tier best practices. Launch a store in days with category pages, product pages, checkout and marketing blocks already tuned for conversion.

Save your precious time and effort spent for finding a solution. Contact us now

Who we are

Intertoons is a custom software company building web apps, mobile apps and online stores for brands that need more than a template. We have been shipping production software for over a decade, and we have been recognised on Clutch and honoured with industry awards more than twice for the work we have done for our clients.

Our work spans solutions development, software consultancy, product engineering, ecommerce development and growth, online promotions and SaaS product development.
